summary: X Financial (NYSE: XYF) disclosed that its board received a preliminary non-binding proposal dated November 6, 2026 from Mangrove Coast Investment Limited, affiliated with Chairman/CEO Justin Tang, to acquire all ordinary shares not already beneficially owned by Mangrove at US$1.005 cash per ordinary share (US$6.03 per ADS, each ADS representing six Class A shares), the equivalent of a US-style going-private buyout. Mangrove holds roughly 93.45% of total voting power. The offer implies a 28.3% premium to the last close and 25.1% to the 30-day VWAP. Tang will recuse; the board intends an independent special committee with financial and legal advisors. Watch committee independence, minority-holder leverage given thin float, and financing/definitive-agreement risk.
